title: CDK10 suppresses nucleic acid sensors-mediated antitumor immunity
model: CT26 mouse colon cancer, kinome knockout library in vivo
contrast: Tumors in immunocompetent vs nude mice (3 vs 3)
paper_method: Not stated in GEO; paper not open access
barcs_calls: 9 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration
verdict: Cdk10 knockouts are depleted in immunocompetent mice, as the paper reports (rank 20 of 713), but after calibrating to the non-targeting guides (14% reached p < 0.05 before) Cdk10 sits at FDR 0.15; Sgk1, Stk11 and Jak2 rank higher.
